svg.title: Kernel master roadmap
svg.desc: A structured diagram showing all directions to expand your kernel: networking, GUI, userspace, drivers, and the combined full OS path.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about what my kernel already has built')
g.text: Boot · memory · scheduler · shell · ELF · PCI · FAT32

g.text: All branches merged · networking + GUI + drivers + apps
